items.title: TD Cowen lifts UnitedHealth, Humana to Buy on improved earnings outlook
items.summary: Investing.com -- TD Cowen upgraded UnitedHealth Group (NYSE: UNH) and Humana (NYSE: HUM) to Buy in notes on Friday. Telling investors that both health insurers have a clearer path to stronger earnings now that pricing in Medicare Advantage, the private alternative to traditional Medicare, has become more rational.
